title: Replicate
lede: Replicate migrates a site built in Webflow, Framer or a similar builder into a Next.js codebase and pushes it to a GitHub repository, at no cost.

points: Aims for one-to-one visual parity between the original site and the generated Next.js app.
Handles the usual migration blockers: images served from the builder's CDN, CMS content and minified JavaScript.
Per the launch comment, blog posts move into a CMS collection and images get CDN support with downsampling.
The launch comment claims 99.98% parity on the large majority of commercial websites.
The output lands in GitHub, so the site can then be worked on with coding agents such as Claude or Codex.

sections.text: Site owners on Webflow, Framer or similar builders who want the site as a code repository they own and can hand to coding agents.
Free. The description and the launch comment both say the tool costs nothing to use.
